Verify if activity appears post-rebuild. 5. **Result:** If contributions remain hidden until manual rebuild, the inference holds. If any activity appears without intervention, the claim is disproven. **Note:** Use the public-text capability to cross-reference GitHub’s official documentation or support forums for explicit statements on default visibility rules.
